notes: The brain's pathways as in a real brain: a two-way link is two fibres, an axon's branches leave it one after another, a much-connected cell forks a twig for every further pathway, chains of parts that fire in the same order are learned as circuits you can play, and every signal is shown passing through its cell. A mandatory first rule: every kind of element has its whole life written, from birth to going (under the i button).
